blocks.text: Expression variables, operators aur qeematon ka mel hai jo nateeja deta hai; maslan 3 + 4 se 7. Pecheeda expressions mein qausain amal ki tarteeb qaboo karti hain.

Class activity: Body Mass Index (BMI) nikalne ka program likhein. User se kilogram mein wazan aur metre mein qad poochein, phir BMI = wazan / qad ka murabba nikal kar us ki darja-bandi ke saath dikhayein.

blocks.title: Python code (har .... ek 4-space indent hai)
blocks.text:
weight = float(input("Weight in kg: "))
height = float(input("Height in m: "))
bmi = weight / height ** 2
print("BMI:", round(bmi, 1))

blocks.prompt: BMI program se 72 kg aur 1.8 m wale shakhs ka BMI kya hai?
blocks.explanation: 72 / 1.8 ** 2 = 72 / 3.24 = 22.2. Darja-bandi ki hadein (maslan 18.5 se 24.9 normal) aam sehat ki rehnumai hain, kitab mein nahi.

items: Expressions nateeja dete hain; qausain tarteeb tay karti hain: (3 + 4) * 2 = 14. BMI = wazan / qad ** 2.
